text:
Nora H: Heads-up: platform will start honoring a normalized routing header next week: X-RW-Route. Supported values: `latency` and `economy`. Also want X-Quota-Bucket for console attribution. Please make SDKs canonicalize casing and accept legacy keys `route_hint` / `RouteHint` as fallbacks. cc @Ben K @Priya S

Ben K: Can we make this opt-in? Changing defaults worries me. Lots of customers have baked behavior.

Priya S: DevEx preference: opt-in for public GA. But include a helper remap we can enable for internal canary to reduce noise. Also request: console should show sample-level "applied route" so teams can sanity-check.

Jae (platform): Server plan: accept legacy names for 120 days, default server routing unchanged. We'll emit sampled telemetry `routing.legacy_seen` and `routing.header_conflict` when both headers present. SDKs should expose an explicit builder option and env var `REDWOOD_ROUTE_BEHAVIOR=off|opt-in|mirror`.

ci-bot: deploy planned: routing-api compat canary -> 2026-03-20 01:30 UTC (https://deploys.redwood.internal/routing-api/compat-canary) :rocket:

Ben K: For Go/TS we'll add an explicit client option `WithRouteBehavior(mode string)` and support the env var. Default = off for published releases. For internal builds we can default to `mirror`. Will log an info when remap happens.

Priya S: Python helper sketch (RFC):
```python
def normalize_route(headers, route=None):
    # precedence: explicit param > X-RW-Route > legacy keys
    if route:
        headers['X-RW-Route'] = route
    else:
        for k in ('X-RW-Route','x-rw-route','route_hint','RouteHint'):
            if k in headers:
                headers['X-RW-Route'] = headers[k]
                break
    headers['X-Quota-Bucket'] = headers.get('X-Quota-Bucket','sdk:py:unversioned')
```

Ben K: TS pseudo:```ts
function normalize(headers: Record<string,string>, route?:string){
  if(route) headers['X-RW-Route']=route;
  else { const keys=['X-RW-Route','route_hint','RouteHint']; for(const k of keys) if(headers[k]){ headers['X-RW-Route']=headers[k]; break }}
  headers['X-Quota-Bucket']=headers['X-Quota-Bucket'] || `sdk:ts:${SDK_VERSION}`
}
```

Nora H: Please emit telemetry event `sdk.route_normalize` with tags {lang,mode,remapped:true|false}. Also increment `sdk.route_conflict` when both legacy and normalized header present. Console team wants a small tile: "Routing remaps (sampled)" linking to examples.

Jae (platform): Confirmed: server accepts legacy until 2026-09-15. We'll sample raw header pairs and attach a trace link when conflicts occur. We'll provide a tenant-level sample rate and surface a mismatch metric in console.

Priya S: We'll ship SDK helpers behind feature flags. Add CHANGELOG migration notes and a tiny FAQ: "Which header wins?" -> explicit param > X-RW-Route > legacy keys. Also include snippet showing env var to opt-in.

Ben K: I'll open Go + TS PRs today with tests and telemetry counters. Will default to `off` in public CI but flip `mirror` in the internal canary pipeline.

ci-bot: PRs created: go-client#214, ts-client#987 (links: https://git.internal/go-client/pull/214, https://git.internal/ts-client/pull/987)

Nora H: Thanks. Quick review sync tomorrow 9:00 PT to confirm telemetry dashboards and release notes language. :thumbsup:
